subject.title: fix(proxy): bound managed proxy CA file reads

question: What managed-proxy CA-bundle ceiling is safe for existing `proxy.tls.caFile` users: approve 256 KiB with compatibility evidence, select a different established limit, or require an upgrade path?
rationale: The change intentionally converts previously accepted configured files into startup failures, and the repository policy treats config and fallback changes as compatibility-sensitive; source and tests do not establish an existing managed-proxy size contract.

options.title: Approve 256 KiB with evidence
options.body: Keep the proposed ceiling after showing it covers supported managed-proxy CA bundles and documenting the intended operator failure mode.

options.title: Use a different compatible ceiling
options.body: Adopt a limit backed by the managed-proxy owner’s deployment knowledge and add focused boundary coverage for that agreed value.

options.title: Defer the cap
options.body: Pause this hardening change until a compatibility-safe policy or migration path is available.

recommendation.title: Approve 256 KiB with evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed ceiling after showing it covers supported managed-proxy CA bundles and documenting the intended operator failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the managed HTTPS proxy CA-trust contract affected by the new rejection threshold.
